_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow for HiDream-O1-Image Dev MXFP8 text-to-image. HiDream-O1 is a genuinely unified pixel-native ~8B model: its Qwen3-VL text backbone runs inside diffusion_model.* every sampling step, and its decoder is a pixel-space conversion VAE. So CheckpointLoaderSimple supplies MODEL, CLIP (a tokenizer-only TE) and VAE all three -- do NOT add a separate CLIPLoader, and do not load the Gemma-4 encoder here; that belongs to the optional prompt-refiner branch, not to this model. Uses the SamplerCustom chain because ModelNoiseScale sets the absolute training noise scale: 7.5 for Dev, 8.0 for base (8.0 is also the built-in default in comfy/supported_models.py). Steps 28 for Dev; base wants 40-50. Requires ComfyUI from 2026-05-12 or later. Width/height default to 1024 rather than the model's native 2048 because pixel-space generation has no VAE 8x downsample, so resolution costs far more VRAM here than with FLUX. HiDreamO1PatchSeamSmoothing (node 12) is included because a patch-based pixel transformer leaves a visible rectangular seam grid in flat texture -- wood grain, paper, bokeh. It runs extra offset passes over the last 20% of sampling and blends them, which measurably cleans that up; drop the node and rewire 8/9 to node 3 if you want raw speed. Replace PROMPT_TEXT, WIDTH, HEIGHT, SEED, and FILENAME_PREFIX as needed.
